registered_at: 2026-11-02, after phase 1 results, before any phase-2 model call
purpose: Decompose the phase-1 gap between E (executable PGL) and S/G (free text) into sampling noise, the net-change facts in the E prompt, and a generic cue, all within the executable PGL format.
model_cases_scoring: Same as REGISTRATION.json (gemini-3.8-flash, 147 J3 cases, H-anonymised transient pairs, sigma-graph keys for free text). Concurrency 300.

conditions.E_r2: E resampled with the identical prompt
conditions.E_nofacts: E prompt with the 'Endpoint-derived facts' block (net bond changes computed from initial/target) removed
conditions.E_cue: E prompt plus the generic cue text of condition G

primary_analyses_heavy_atom_hidden_event.noise: Among events omitted in E: re-appearance rate in E_r2 vs. rate known in free text (S or G). Inert knowledge over noise is supported if the free-text rate exceeds the E_r2 re-appearance rate by >= 15 pp; additionally report free-text knowledge among events omitted in both E and E_r2.
primary_analyses_heavy_atom_hidden_event.net_facts: E_nofacts minus mean(E, E_r2) hidden-event recall; effect present if the 95% case-clustered CI excludes 0.
primary_analyses_heavy_atom_hidden_event.cue_in_pgl: E_cue minus mean(E, E_r2) hidden-event recall; effect present if the 95% CI excludes 0.

secondary: same for all events and H-transfer events
sigma-L1 per condition and differences vs mean(E, E_r2)
note: Phase-1 primary result is unchanged by this phase; these analyses qualify its interpretation.
